Method of Attack: Modification of logging configuration file to construct a malicious configuration using a JDBC Appender with a data source referencing a JNDI URI to execute remote code
Impacted Systems: Systems using Log4j versions from 2.0-beta7 up to and including 2.17.0 (excluding backported releases 2.3.2 and 2.12.4)
Attack Vector: Requires attacker to have write permissions to the logging configuration file
